sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added Vitest + React Testing Library test infrastructure — vitest.config.ts, src/test/setup.ts, and test scripts (npm run test, npm run test:run); pre-commit hook now runs the full test suite before every commit (OAK-16)

Added 28 unit tests for useBoosterPackGeneration hook — covers pack card counts, no-duplicate invariants, wildcard selection logic, empty/undersized collection handling, pack history capping, state updates, and analytics call counts (OAK-17)

Added 23 unit tests for utils/categories.ts — covers Firestore data mapping, in-memory cache behavior, empty-Firestore fallback with setDoc seeding, error handling, getDefaultCategories purity, and categoriesToLegacyFormat conversion (OAK-18)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added ErrorBoundary component — catches uncaught render errors and lazy-load failures, showing a recovery UI with error details and a reload button instead of a blank screen (OAK-12)
Converted admin page imports (EditPage, EditCardPage, CategoriesPage) to React.lazy() with a Suspense spinner fallback — main bundle reduced from ~1,414 kB to ~1,289 kB (OAK-13)

Extracted pack generation tuning constants (MIN_WILDCARD_ATTEMPTS, RETRY_MULTIPLIER, PACK_HISTORY_LIMIT, MAX_PACKS_PER_EXPORT) into src/constants/generation.ts; replaced all remaining hardcoded "spoonbill" strings with COLLECTION_IDS.SPOONBILL; removed redundant getCollectionName special-case (OAK-14)
Added three-tier logging strategy to generateBoosterPack; Tier-2 pack-level slot failures now also fire exception({ fatal: false }) to surface in GA analytics (OAK-15)
Removed @firebasegen/default-connector file: dependency and deleted dataconnect/ and dataconnect-generated/ scaffold directories — were never used and had zero imports in src/ (OAK-19)
Added Husky v9 + lint-staged pre-commit hook — automatically runs ESLint (auto-fix) on staged .ts/.tsx files and a full tsc --noEmit type-check on every commit (OAK-20)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Removed duplicate local Card interfaces from edit.tsx and editcard.tsx — both pages now import the canonical Card type from src/types/index.ts (OAK-10)
Added collectionName? to the canonical Card interface in src/types/index.ts to cover the field used by admin pages (OAK-10)
Replaced { [key: string]: any } cardsData state in index.tsx with { [key: string]: Card[] } — completes the any→Card[] migration across the primary data path (OAK-11)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added Card interface to src/types/index.ts and typed the full card pipeline — eliminates any[] throughout pack generation and Excel export hooks (OAK-38)
Renamed LegacyCollection to Collection — the 'Legacy' prefix was a holdover that no longer reflected the type's role (OAK-38)
Replaced positional pack[8] wildcard lookup in Excel export with a semantic pack.find() based on collection membership — export no longer breaks if pack slot order changes (OAK-39)
Hardened BASE_COLLECTION_IDS with as const satisfies readonly string[] — TypeScript now errors on any mutation or reorder attempt (OAK-39)
Extracted magic numbers from wildcard retry logic into named constants MIN_WILDCARD_ATTEMPTS and RETRY_MULTIPLIER; fixed stale warning message (OAK-40)
Moved analytics calls out of the private generateBoosterPack function — generation is now a pure operation; a single timing() event fires per batch in generatePacks instead of per pack (OAK-40)
Removed dead ./src/hooks/**/* content path from tailwind.config.js — hooks contain no Tailwind class strings (OAK-40)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Extracted collection constants (COLLECTION_IDS, BASE_COLLECTION_IDS, COLLECTION_DISPLAY_NAMES, COLLECTION_COLORS) into src/constants/collections.ts — eliminates duplication between index.tsx and collection-badge.tsx (OAK-9)
Extracted pack generation logic into useBoosterPackGeneration hook (src/hooks/use-booster-pack-generation.ts) — separates generation state and logic from page UI orchestration (OAK-7)
Extracted Excel export into useExcelExport hook (src/hooks/use-excel-export.ts) with dynamic xlsx import — defers ~1.6 MB bundle until first export, creating a separate Vite chunk (OAK-8)

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed category cache not being set when Firestore returns an empty collection — the result of the default-category fallback is now cached at the getCategories() level, preventing redundant Firestore calls and potential inconsistency on subsequent loads (OAK-25)

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed stale closure in the Firebase sign-in effect on the Card Management page — list.reload() now always uses the current reload reference via useRef, eliminating a potential stale-data risk (OAK-27)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Removed unused editcard.tsx component and ui/dialog.tsx wrapper — both had zero imports across the codebase (OAK-31)
Removed orphaned @radix-ui/react-dialog dependency that was only used by the deleted dialog.tsx

sections.title: Bug Fixes & Performance
items: Fixed theme hook crashing in non-browser environments — localStorage is now accessed only after confirming a browser context is available
Fixed unsafe theme value cast that allowed arbitrary strings to be applied as CSS classes on the document root — stored value is now validated before use
Eliminated redundant re-render caused by a self-referential useEffect in the theme provider — each setter now applies DOM changes directly
Stabilized theme context function references with useCallback and useMemo — components that consume the theme context no longer re-render on unrelated updates

sections.title: Admin Form Validation
items: Added input validation to the Edit Card and Categories admin forms — empty names, malformed card numbers, and special-character category IDs are now rejected before reaching Firestore (OAK-30)
Inline error messages appear next to each offending field for clear, immediate feedback
Category ID field is now read-only when editing an existing category to prevent orphaning cards in Firestore

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed broken Sign-In button on the unauthorized page — Clerk's SignInButton now correctly wraps the HeroUI Button so click events are not intercepted by react-aria (OAK-26)
Removed the close (×) button and backdrop-click dismissal from the unauthorized modal — previously left users on a blank white screen with no way to navigate (OAK-32)
Replaced invalid <Link>-inside-<Button> pattern on the Go Back button with programmatic navigation via useNavigate — fixes assistive-technology compatibility and cross-browser click behavior

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed pack generation producing only 6 cards instead of 10 — each base category now always contributes exactly 2 cards (OAK-22)
Fixed Excel export sometimes firing twice or not at all on rapid clicks — export now uses a direct call with a double-click guard (OAK-23)
Fixed wildcard slot crash when no eligible wildcard categories are configured — slot is now skipped gracefully with a warning (OAK-24)

sections.title: Global Design Revamp
items: Complete visual overhaul with a modern, minimalist aesthetic and glassmorphism effects
Redesigned Home, About, Edit Dashboard, Edit Card, and Categories pages
Implemented smooth entrance animations and improved responsive layouts
Added color-coded collection badges for better visual distinction

sections.title: New Features
items: Added Booster Pack History: View the last 10 generated packs in an accordion layout
Restored main table view for current packs while keeping history accessible
Implemented 'Export to Excel' with improved modal interface

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed category duplication bug in database and UI
Resolved issue where cards were duplicated in the Edit Dashboard

sections.title: Updates
items:
Adjusted wildcard generation to limit card sections
- Added a toggle to limit the booster packs that can be put in the wildcard slot

sections.title: Hotfixes
items: Booster generation now always takes the first 8 cards from: Tropical Rainforest, Children's Zoo, California Trail, and African Savanna (in that order)
Data loading ensures these base categories are included even if they are not listed in Firestore categories
Improved resilience when a category is empty by skipping gracefully during selection
Export columns mirror the fixed ordering and display names; corrected display to "African Savanna"

sections.title: Hotfixes
items: Pack generation now uses all active categories for the 9th card (no longer limited to hardcoded categories)
Editing a card now correctly updates its category by moving the document between collections without errors

Added the ability to create, update, and delete card categories (EB)
